# Executive Summary

This report documents the **final outcome** of the Miami Beach Fire Department Mid-Mount Ladder Workgroup evaluation process (Q1 2026). Following structured multi-day evaluations of hydraulic rescue tools, cut-off saws, vehicle stabilization systems, and specialty tools, the workgroup has reached consensus on final equipment selections.

This report is submitted to **Fire Chief Digna Abello** and the **Health & Safety Committee**.

## Final Selections Summary

| Category | Selected Equipment | Platform |
|----------|--------------------|----------|
| Cut-Off Saw | DeWalt 12" Battery Cut-Off Saw | Frontline |
| Chainsaw | DeWalt 18" Chainsaw | Frontline |
| Stabilization | 4 × Holmatro V-Struts | Frontline |
| Spreader | Hurst SP 777 E3 Connect | CAPTIUM |
| Cutter | Hurst S 789 E3 Connect | CAPTIUM |
| Ram | Hurst CR 522 E3 Connect | CAPTIUM |
| Specialty (Trial) | Holmatro T1 | Trial |
| Heavy Extrication | Hurst M40 (40" spreader) | 300 (BC) |
| Future Addition | Lifting Struts (pending) | 300 / Capt 5 |

# Evaluation Framework

The workgroup employed a standardized scoring model across all 14 products from 6 manufacturers.

**Scoring Dimensions:**

| Dimension | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Capability | Force output, cutting capacity, spreading distance |
| Usability | Ergonomics, control interface, operator comfort |
| Maintainability | Service requirements, durability, field-repairability |
| Deployability | Storage footprint, activation speed, weight |

Each dimension scored 0–100. Composite **Overall Score** computed as weighted aggregate.

# Specialty Tools

## Holmatro T1 — Score: 82.23

Six-function tool (cut, wedge, ram, spread, hammer, lift) at 17 lbs. Trial basis as Rabbit tool replacement candidate.

## Hurst M40 — Score: 78.80

40" heavy spreader for 300 (Battalion Chief) vehicle. Supplemental heavy rescue capability.

# Apparatus Deployment

## Frontline (L1 / L3)

All Hurst E3 CAPTIUM tools + 4× V-Struts + DeWalt saw/chainsaw + T1 trial.

## Command Level (300 / Captain 5)

Hurst M40 + batteries + charging station + future lifting struts.

# Training Plan

**Train-the-Trainer Model:**

1. Vendor training for workgroup SMEs
2. Shift-based department rollout (no overtime)
3. Deep familiarization on all systems

All training completed before apparatus enters service.
